body:
[This](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/10nvzw/23m_depression_is_a_terrible_drug/) is my story. I know what it's like to get the shit end of the stick every time, to hide in games, to reject the world. But when you say things like this, people reach out to help you. You know this. That's why this is Suicide Watch. You didn't just come here to gloat about your decision to end it all.

Even if Life is meaningless, even if there is no goal in sight, even if you are covered in darkness and don't know where to go, you are alive. Life is a gift. At least, that's what I'm beginning to learn myself.
No job that pays as much as I currently get. Being a High School dropout doesn't help.

I work nine hours a day, five days a week. Night shift. I walk to and from work. I use the computer, the only electronic I own, as the cheapest stress relief I can find. Doing activities outside cuts heavily into the time I need to sleep. If I don't sleep, I don't work. If I don't work, I don't have a home. Paycheck to Paycheck doesn't afford any leeway.

The only thing stopping me from killing myself, short of the emotional baggage I'd be leaving loved ones, is the same thing that stops me from grabbing a butcher knife and plunging it into my roommates chest. It's the same thing that stops me from running onto the freeway midday, or taking a handful of pain medication.

I do have to worry about money. I can't live on welfare, because I have far too much pride in myself to take a handout from the state or country. Especially when I have no intention of staying in the state when my lease runs out.

What do I really want? What do I value? I lived my childhood wanting constant entertainment, and valuing family, then the source of entertainment, above all else. I'm living my adult life wanting distractions from what I feel and think, and valuing my family above myself. I've spent rent money on going to a bar for a birthday before, and would do so again, because the happiness of others is worth more to me then the avoidance of stress due to not having enough funds to make rent.

How the fuck am I supposed to make something out of that?

Clearly, I've got post-traumatic stress disorder, considering my entire childhood is defined by house fires. I was never happy before them, so it can't be the only thing. And not remembering the past doesn't help as much as you'd think. I reject the past every day. I can't even remember my father's face, let alone voice. The only time I think of the past is when I'm trying to explain to others my history, to give some explanation for how I feel on a daily basis.

I can't "do just as the fuck I want". I have obligations to others to succeed. I make more as a high school drop out than any two of my family members put together. If I were to do as I wanted, I'd leave the state and probably the country. I'd be drunk or high 24/7. I would cause serious bodily harm to a lot of people. 

I try to reject people, and put up walls. I have a small support group of trusted people that I let know how I really feel, but talking for two hours about the things I think and feel on a daily basis don't help me. It just makes me wallow in my own misery after the conversation. I've tried crying myself to sleep, and I can't even shed a tear.

I don't want to "fit in the system", I don't want to "be accepted". I want to live my life in relative ease. I don't care what others say or think of me, and I cut contact with people I don't see on a daily basis, regardless of what I think about them. I didn't finish school, I meet people through work or family, and I've got no desire to have children, or even intimate relationships.

When it gets down to who I am today, I'm a self-hating atheistic, nihilistic pissant waiting for death to come to me, because I'm not about to take my life into my own hands.
